notes: How this part was researched: about sixty web searches (the session's allowance of 200 ran out before every candidate had a second search), then pages opened directly with the kit's honest User-Agent (states/net.py), robots.txt read first and obeyed. Every finding below was read on the page it cites.

Left out and why: creggformn.com (linked beside Wendy Cregg's name on the Senate District 49 Republicans' page, but it answers with a bot check, so it was not read and is not recorded; that party page announces her candidacy without the word 'endorsed', and the endorsement is reported only by Eden Prairie Local News, so no endorsement is recorded). mncourts.gov answered 403, so neither judge has an official page here. albertleatribune.com, pineandlakes.com and minnlawyer.com ask Claude's agents to stay out, so the years Christopher Shoff (search results say first elected 2006), Ross Nelson (appointed to the Pequot Lakes board, 2024-25) and Kelsie Kingstrom (County Attorney since 2022) took office are not recorded; the Pequot Lakes district's board page answered 404. Ages given in newspaper candidate profiles were not turned into birth years. Jobs (chief deputy, county finance officer) are not public offices and are not recorded.

Nothing found beyond the filing for: Cyle Cramer, Joseph Fischer, Brenda Davis, Adam Koch, Matt Treichler, Nicholas Gessell, Jackie Young, Paul Wunderlich, Benton Bakke, Margaret Durenberger, Brad Flemming, Cristin Craig, Ross Nelson, John Peck, Elizabeth Taylor-Schiro, Paul Peltier, Wendy Cregg. A second pass with searching would be worth it for campaign websites.

Verifier, 2026-10-02: all 21 findings re-opened with the kit's User-Agent and confirmed on the page cited. One corrected: Amy Bullyan's start year 2023 rested on a newspaper not cited by url; the district's page says 'Elected 2022', so the start year is left blank and the office line says elected 2022.
